source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Three local campgrounds added: Kennedy Park & Marina (Hancock County, concessionaire), Mountwood Park (Wood County, FCFS) and Virginia Point Park (City of Kenova). Excluded: Snow-Shoe-style long-term parks, Paden City Park (no web presence), Lewis County Park (no camping), and Plum Orchard WMA (state). Krodel Park is held (Good Sam pin wrong). About 30 private campgrounds, many around the New River Gorge, are unmatched in OSM.
